basic_info.description: Amazing San Francisco Skyline Views from this architecturally stunning 3-level, 2BR/2.5BA townhouse in Corona Heights. Kitchen and baths are in good original condition, though they could benefit from some modern updates. Designed for open-concept living, this home boasts soaring 18' cathedral ceilings and expansive windows that showcase the iconic San Francisco skyline & outlooks to Noe Valley. The main living area features an impressive formal dining area, a step down living room with walkout deck, new flooring, woodburning fireplace and wonderful natural light from so many panes of glass. The primary suite is located on the third level and features a wall of windows framing dramatic water views, another wood-burning fireplace, and vaulted ceilings. On the lower level is a spacious second bedroom with ensuite bath providing privacy and convenient access to the in-unit laundry. One car garage and extra storage.
